acceptance: Explorer views show headline, blocks, workloads, correctness, variance, locality, reference, and full concurrency-curve evidence, with diagnostics presented alongside the scalar.
The complete cohort key, score type, methodology version, manifest hash, and tuning attestation are visible and used for comparison filtering.
Invalid, missing, unsupported, non-comparable, client-limited, or unqualified results cannot appear as valid ranked scores.
Publication and ingestion verify frozen methodology major, qualified reference-vector ID, and exact frozen manifest hash; provisional bundles remain unranked and CI rejects mismatches.
Documentation states that BenchBox scores are synthetic and are not official TPC metrics; benchmark-specific and official TPC metrics remain available without semantic changes.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. Numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, thresholds, and the M4 reference remain pilot hypotheses until methodology freeze.
description: Add a separate Results Explorer and documentation surface for qualified BenchBox-Power and BenchBox-Throughput scores. Do not reinterpret the existing meta-leaderboard or expose provisional pilot results as headline scores.
